sections_en.text: This document sets out the inspection steps P1 every five years Y5 for dry chemical powder fire extinguishers of 6 kg and 12 kg capacity; dry chemical powder is used to extinguish all types of fires0

The first draft was prepared and tested by Eng. Hosny Hassan Hussein, reviewed by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater, and approved by Eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Meleigy: General Manager of El-Shabab Gas Power Station

Approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at East Delta Electricity Production Company and the company coordinator for the Maintenance Procedure Information System, and certified by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Soliman, General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company0

rows: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Fence off the area and place warning signs
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, 00 etc.)
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 000 etc.
Tool bag consisting of a wrench set (open-end, ring) and assorted screwdrivers
Body test set, dryer
Collect the cylinders at the equipment body test set0
Fill the cylinders with water using the water pump of the set, then fit the coupling to the cylinders0
Move the test valve to the Test position and open the test water source and the main air source0
Operate the body test set to start the test for 5 extinguishers in one batch up to a pressure of 35 bar
Leave the cylinder under this pressure for 5 minutes; after the test succeeds, release the pressure by moving the test valve to the Release position
Remove the powder cylinders, empty them of water and dry them well with a special dryer.
Refill the powder cylinders with new ones and check that their pressure has become ideal0
Seal the valves of the cylinders0
Inspect the powder hoses and check that there are no cracks in them0
Carry out the necessary scraping and painting of the extinguisher body0
Affix the sticker with the test date0

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedure Information System
Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Fire Fighting Systems | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: FS-035-r0a | Equipment: Dry chemical powder fire extinguishers, 6 kg and 12 kg capacity
Issued to: East Delta Electricity Production Company
Status: Approved
Approval date: 07 March 2006 | Procedure: Inspection every five years (P1-Y5)
Next review date: March 2011
Introduction
This document sets out the inspection steps P1 every five years Y5 for dry chemical powder fire extinguishers of 6 kg and 12 kg capacity; dry chemical powder is used to extinguish all types of fires0
The first draft was prepared and tested by Eng. Hosny Hassan Hussein, reviewed by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater, and approved by Eng. Hamdy Abdel Mawla Meleigy: General Manager of El-Shabab Gas Power Station
Approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at East Delta Electricity Production Company and the company coordinator for the Maintenance Procedure Information System, and certified by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Soliman, General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at East Delta Electricity Production Company0
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Fence off the area and place warning signs | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, 00 etc.) | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Occupational safety and health equipment such as safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves 000 etc. | 
Tool bag consisting of a wrench set (open-end, ring) and assorted screwdrivers | 
Body test set, dryer | 
Work to be Carried Out
Collect the cylinders at the equipment body test set0 | 1.
Fill the cylinders with water using the water pump of the set, then fit the coupling to the cylinders0 | 2.
Move the test valve to the Test position and open the test water source and the main air source0 | 3.
Operate the body test set to start the test for 5 extinguishers in one batch up to a pressure of 35 bar | 4.
Leave the cylinder under this pressure for 5 minutes; after the test succeeds, release the pressure by moving the test valve to the Release position | 5.
Remove the powder cylinders, empty them of water and dry them well with a special dryer. | 6.
Refill the powder cylinders with new ones and check that their pressure has become ideal0 | 7.
Seal the valves of the cylinders0 | 8.
Inspect the powder hoses and check that there are no cracks in them0 | 9.
Carry out the necessary scraping and painting of the extinguisher body0 | 10.
Affix the sticker with the test date0 | 11.
